newsitem.title: USA: US Airways to redeem series B preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: US Airways to redeem series B preferred shares.

text.p: US Airways Group Inc said Monday that it has exercised its right to redeem all of its outstanding series B preferred stock at $51.75 per depositary share plus accrued dividends of 36.46 cents. The shares must be redeemed by Sept. 15.

The company said it will save about $19 million in annual dividend payments as a result. US Airways added that along with the repurchase and conversion earlier this year of its Series F and T preferred stock, it will recognize a total of approximately $46 million in savings on annual dividend payments.

The Series B stock trades publicly as depositary shares, each of which represents 1/100 of a share of the preferred stock. Each depositary share is convertible, at the holder's option, into 2.4925 shares of the company's common stock. Holders of depositary shares who wish to convert must do so before the close of business on September 15, said the company. At a common stock price of $36.50 per share, the closing price on August 15, each depositary share would have a value in common stock of $90.98, less any commissions and other expenses. This compares to the cash redemption payment of approximately $52.11 including accrued dividends.
